summary: ACTOOS ONE - Mobile Money Payment & Order Tracking Testing. All 4 requested features verified successfully. Mobile Money option appears in PaymentMethodSelector, MobileMoneyPaymentSheet opens correctly when selecting Mobile Money and clicking Commander, complete payment flow simulation works (phone entry → operator detection → confirmation → processing → success), and OrderTrackingMap is properly integrated in OrderTrackingScreen (button appears when order status is picked_up/on_the_way/delivering).
critical_code_review_comments: MobileMoneyPaymentSheet properly imported and integrated in CheckoutScreen.jsx (line 19)
handlePlaceOrder correctly detects 'mobile_money' payment method and opens sheet (lines 266-269)
handleMobileMoneySuccess callback properly processes payment result (lines 276-283)
PaymentMethodSelector includes mobile_money option with correct data-testid (lines 12-19)
OrderTrackingMap properly integrated with 'Suivre en temps réel' button (lines 444-462)
Map button correctly shows only when status is picked_up/on_the_way/delivering
TouchPay service properly simulates payment in demo mode (simulatePaymentConfirmation)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile Money payment flow fully functional in demo mode. TouchPay API is MOCKED (no real API keys). OrderTrackingMap shows when order status is picked_up/on_the_way/delivering. All 4 requested tests passed.

test_1_mobile_money_option.details: Mobile Money option appears in PaymentMethodSelector on payment step. Shows 'Mobile Money' with description 'Orange Money, Moov Money'. Has data-testid='payment-method-mobile_money'.

test_2_mobile_money_sheet_opening.details: When user selects Mobile Money and clicks 'Commander' button, MobileMoneyPaymentSheet opens correctly. Shows 'Paiement Mobile Money' title, phone input, supported methods (Orange Money, Moov Money, Sama Money), amount breakdown.

test_3_payment_flow_simulation.details: Complete flow tested: (1) Enter phone +223 70 12 34 56, (2) Orange Money detected automatically, (3) Fees calculated (1.5% = 74 FCFA), (4) Confirmation screen with 'Mode démo' warning, (5) Processing screen 'Confirmation en attente...', (6) Success screen 'Paiement réussi!' with transaction ID DEMO_xxx.

test_4_order_tracking_map.details: OrderTrackingMap component properly integrated. 'Suivre en temps réel' button (data-testid='view-map-btn') appears when order status is picked_up/on_the_way/delivering. Map modal uses Leaflet with restaurant marker, customer marker, driver marker, and route polyline. Driver position simulated when no external position provided.

mocked_apis.touchpay_mobile_money: MOCKED - TouchPay API simulated in touchPayService.js. Uses simulatePaymentConfirmation() for demo mode. No real API keys configured (REACT_APP_TOUCHPAY_API_KEY not set).
